facts.text: The entry hands the same logical review packet to both sides and adjudicates both with one validator.
Patches and logs enter the packet only after the host has produced, reviewed and redacted them.

constraints: No real model calls in this stage.

goal.request: Verify that the unified offline entry produces consistent adjudication for the fixture backend.
acceptance: Both sides receive byte-identical logical packets.
A P1 finding on either side fails the round.
Verify replays an archived round without calling any wrapper.
